back: A substance that changes the way the body or mind works.
Tolerance: bigger dose needed for same effect. Dependence: need for the drug, with withdrawal symptoms when stopped.

front: Effects of heavy alcohol use on the liver
back: Fatty liver → alcoholic hepatitis → cirrhosis (scar tissue); raised liver cancer risk.
Ethanol crossing the placenta causes restricted growth, facial features and permanent brain damage.
Addictive; raises heart rate and blood pressure; vasoconstriction; stickier platelets.
Carcinogens; paralyses cilia; more mucus; bronchitis and emphysema.
Impaired short-term memory and coordination; dependence; raised psychosis risk in vulnerable young people.
Stimulant: dopamine release, euphoria, no sleep or appetite; strong dependence; paranoia and psychosis.

front: Why is misusing codeine syrup dangerous?
back: Codeine (an opioid, partly converted to morphine) depresses breathing, especially with alcohol; causes dependence.
